description: This Java file contains unit tests for the SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder class in the org.eclipse.hono.auth package. It verifies the behavior of password matching for different hash functions (default, SHA-512, Bcrypt), handling of malformed hashes, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder, testing password verification logic for different hashing algorithms and input scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the encoder instance before each test.

methods.name: testMatchesFallsBackToDefaultHashFunction
methods.description: Tests that the encoder correctly falls back to the default hash function when none is specified.

methods.name: testMatchesSucceedsForCorrectPassword
methods.description: Verifies password matching using the SHA-512 hash function.

methods.name: testMatchesSucceedsForMatchingBCryptPassword
methods.description: Verifies password matching using bcrypt hash function.

methods.name: testMatchesCredentialsFailsForNonMatchingPassword
methods.description: Ensures that non-matching credentials are rejected.

methods.name: testMatchesCredentialsFailsForMalformedPwdHash
methods.description: Checks that malformed password hashes cause verification to fail without exceptions.

methods.name: testMatchesCredentialsFailsForMalformedSalt
methods.description: Checks that malformed salt causes verification to fail without exceptions.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Helper method to generate password hashes using specified hash functions and salt.
